author: Tamás Pál
name: Rask WASM + ASP.NET Host
description: A browser-WASM Rask SPA hosted by an ASP.NET app — bundle served statically, with an `/api/weatherforecast` endpoint demonstrating the client↔host round trip.

auth.description: Scaffold a cookie-backed login: the host serves /api/login + /api/me + /auth/logout, the client hydrates the user and gates a protected /members page.
